title: What the Member Is Taken to Have Been Left to Bear on Settled Rider Claims
content:
A recovery onto a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card turns in part on what the member themselves was left to bear on the claims another payer settled.

What the member was left to bear is the amount those claims were recognised at less what that rider paid, never less than nothing, where the member holds such a rider that is in force and its own record shows it paid on a claim settled in that stretch; it is the whole amount those claims were recognised at, where the member holds such a rider that is in force and claims were recognised in that stretch but it paid nothing on them; and it is nothing in every other case.

*The rider meant is a dental, vision and hearing rider of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders. The amount a claim was recognised at, and the amount the rider paid on it, are both read from that rider's own settled claim records, taken by the day the claim was processed and over the stretch of the card's record being looked at.*

**The three cases set side by side.**

| The rider's settled claims in the stretch | What the member was left to bear |
|---|---|
| the rider is in force and paid something on a claim settled in the stretch | the amount those claims were recognised at, less what the rider paid, and never less than nothing |
| the rider is in force, claims were recognised in the stretch, and the rider paid nothing on them | the whole amount those claims were recognised at |
| neither | nothing |

**Worked through on hypothetical claims.** A rider in force settled two claims in the stretch, recognised at 220.00 USD in all, on which the rider paid 150.00 USD: what the member was left to bear is 70.00 USD. Had the rider paid 260.00 USD on claims recognised at 220.00 USD, the subtraction would fall below nothing and the figure is held at nothing. Had the rider been in force with claims recognised at 220.00 USD and nothing paid on them, the member was left to bear the whole 220.00 USD. Where no rider is in force at all, the figure is nothing whatever the claims show.
